title: 第19章 完事后立即滚第20章 灵剑符
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
峰上有一座楼阁。
李蒙飞身而下，落在了楼阁外的院子中。
李蒙扫了一眼四周。
苍老的身躯不紧不慢的向阁楼大门走去。
来到阁楼大门前的李蒙推门而入。
只听“咯吱”一声。
阁楼的大门被打开了。
李蒙走了进去。
在二楼，李蒙找到了曲师叔。
隔帘后的床榻上隐隐约约可见一道盘腿而坐的曼妙娇躯。
李蒙撩开隔帘走了进去。
盘坐在床榻上的曲师叔顿时映入了李蒙眼中。
曲师叔的气息有些紊乱。
脸色也略显惨白。
浑身有灵力溢出的异象。
曲柔睁开了双眼，面无表情看着李蒙。
眼中闪过了一丝轻蔑与厌恶。
“都追到我的洞府了，男人果然没有一个好东西，来吧，完事后立即滚！”
【-60好感】
系统的提升让李蒙默然无语。

看来这次曲师叔与苏灿的斗法没有那么简单。
其中肯定存在不为人知的隐情。
好在副职经验没有减少。
李蒙没有多问，也没有多说什么。
伸手在腰间的储物袋上一拍。
三瓶丹药飞出了储物袋落在了曲柔身旁。
李蒙朝着曲师叔作揖行礼。
“这些丹药能够为曲师叔恢复伤势，师侄告辞！”
说着，李蒙转身离去了。
头也不回的下了楼，走出了阁楼。
阁楼外的李蒙飞身而起，御剑远去了。
在阁楼二楼的床榻上。
曲柔低头一脸复杂的看着身旁的三瓶丹药。
他是来送药的？
曲柔伸出纤纤细手拿起了一瓶丹药，摘下了瓶塞。
一股奇异浓郁的丹香顿时映入了鼻中。
那股丹香竟然让曲柔灵力溢出的异象消失了。
content_en:
There is a pavilion on the peak.
Li Meng flew down and landed in the courtyard outside the pavilion.
Li Meng glanced around.
The old body walked slowly towards the attic door.
Li Meng came to the attic door and pushed it open.
Just listen to a "creak".
The attic door was opened.
Li Meng walked in.
On the second floor, Li Meng found Master Qu.
A graceful figure sitting cross-legged could be faintly seen on the bed behind the curtain.
Li Meng opened the curtain and walked in.
Uncle Qu, who was sitting cross-legged on the bed, suddenly came into Li Meng's eyes.
Uncle Qu's breath was a little disordered.
His face was also slightly pale.
There was a vision of spiritual energy overflowing all over his body.
Qu Rou opened her eyes and looked at Li Meng expressionlessly.
A trace of contempt and disgust flashed in his eyes.
"They've chased me all the way to my cave. Men really don't have a good thing. Come on, get out immediately after you're done!"
【-60 favorability】
The improvement of the system left Li Meng speechless.
It seems that the battle between Uncle Qu and Su Can is not that simple this time.
There must be some hidden secret in it.
Fortunately, the deputy experience has not been reduced.
Li Meng didn't ask or say anything more.
He reached out and patted the storage bag on his waist.
Three bottles of elixirs flew out of the storage bag and landed next to Qu Rou.
Li Meng bowed and saluted Master Qu.
"These elixirs can restore Master Qu's injuries. Master Nephew, say goodbye!"
With that said, Li Meng turned and left.
He went downstairs and walked out of the attic without looking back.
Li Meng flew up outside the attic, and his sword went away.
On the bed on the second floor of the attic.
Qu Rou lowered her head and looked at the three bottles of pills beside her with a complicated expression.
Is he here to deliver medicine?
Qu Rou stretched out her slender hand to pick up a bottle of elixir and took off the cork.
A strange and rich red fragrance suddenly entered his nose.
The scent of elixir actually made Qu Rou's vision of overflowing spiritual power disappear.
